description: This file defines several classes related to CRM case management in an OpenERP module, including case categories, stages, and configuration wizards, with methods for workflow operations and module interactions.

classes.name: crm_case_category2
classes.description: Represents a secondary category for CRM cases, with a name and associated section.

classes.name: crm_case_stage
classes.description: Represents a stage in the CRM case workflow, with a name, sequence, and section.

classes.name: crm_cases
classes.description: Extends CRM case functionality with additional fields and methods for stage progression and onchange behavior.

classes.name: crm_menu_config_wizard
classes.description: Wizard class for configuring CRM menu options and importing related XML data, with methods for creation and cancellation actions.

methods.name: stage_next
methods.description: Advances the stage of selected CRM cases to the next stage within their section.

methods.name: onchange_case_id
methods.description: Updates case details based on selected case ID, including contact info.

methods.name: action_create
methods.description: Creates configuration based on wizard selections, importing XML files and updating modules.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Cancels the wizard operation and closes the form.
